fields.why: This is a planned, non-randomized field test with prospective allocation of the 8-mg product by troop and a reporting form changed for the study, so 'retrospective cohort' is not supported (B's quote does not show it). The brief has no quasi-experimental/field-trial value; mixed/other (or prospective cohort) fits better.

Age is named only as a report-form field and 'demographics' only in a limitation, so no age data are reported; A's quote does not name age, and by the same logic perceived gender would also be listed. Level 0 either way; [] preferred.

agreed_errors.verdict: bivariate log-binomial regression, regression_family loglinear as stated, with alternative_reading logistic; primary_measures 'RR' are numerically odds ratios
agreed_errors.why: Every table 'RR' equals the crude odds ratio (withdrawal (38x204)/(63x49)=2.51; anger 1.42; refusal 0.65; vomiting 1.64; survival 0.81), not the risk ratio (1.94 for withdrawal). Both readers flagged the mismatch in view_issues but did not identify ORs or offer the logistic reading.

brief_issues: A's notes still say 'coded as a retrospective cohort' while its value is mixed/other (review merge left stale notes). The brief should name a value or rule for non-randomized field trials/quasi-experiments.
